name: Tổng giá trị tồn kho
query:
SELECT
    w.company AS "Company:Link/Company:150",
    b.warehouse AS "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:200",
    SUM(b.actual_qty) AS "Actual Qty:Float:120",
    SUM(b.stock_value) AS "Stock Value:Currency:150"
FROM `tabBin` b
JOIN `tabWarehouse` w ON w.name = b.warehouse
WHERE 1 = 1
    {% if company %} AND w.company = '{{ company }}' {% endif %}
    {% if warehouse %} AND b.warehouse = '{{ warehouse }}' {% endif %}
GROUP BY w.company, b.warehouse

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'TỔNG CỘNG' AS "Company:Link/Company:150",
    '' AS "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:200",
    SUM(b.actual_qty) AS "Actual Qty:Float:120",
    SUM(b.stock_value) AS "Stock Value:Currency:150"
FROM `tabBin` b
JOIN `tabWarehouse` w ON w.name = b.warehouse
WHERE 1 = 1
    {% if company %} AND w.company = '{{ company }}' {% endif %}
    {% if warehouse %} AND b.warehouse = '{{ warehouse }}' {% endif %}
